info.name: Prafi API
info.description:
Backend API for Prafi (Express + Sequelize + PostgreSQL), with realtime notifications over Socket.IO and emails (nodemailer).

## Setup (once)
1. Import this collection and `Prafi-Local.postman_environment.json`, then select **Prafi Local** (environment dropdown, top right).
2. In **Prafi Local** set `loginEmail` / `loginPassword` (Current value) to the superadmin from `.env` (`SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL` / `SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD`), then Ctrl+S.
3. Start the server (`npm run dev` or `npm run build && npm start`). `baseUrl` is `http://localhost:4000`.
4. Email: set `SMTP_HOST`, `SMTP_PORT`, `SMTP_SECURE`, `SMTP_USER`, `SMTP_PASS`, `MAIL_FROM` in `.env` to send real emails. Set `FRONTEND_URL` to the frontend's address: the forgot-password email links to `<FRONTEND_URL>/reset-password`. Without `SMTP_HOST` (development) emails are printed in the server log and the OTP / activation token is returned in `meta.verification` and saved as `{{otp}}` / `{{verifyToken}}`.

## Login and roles
- Every request uses **Bearer `{{token}}`** (set on the collection; requests inherit it). Public requests have *No Auth*.
- **Auth → Login** saves the token to `{{token}}` (valid **1 hour**). To switch role, change `loginEmail` / `loginPassword` (or the Login body) and send Login again.
- The **name of each request says who can call it**: `(All roles)` = superadmin, disnakertrans, admin and tenant; `(superadmin, disnakertrans, admin)`, `(admin)`, `(tenant)`… = only those roles; `(Public)` = no login. Any other role gets **403**.
- Every account must have a **verified email** (`mailActive: true`) and an **active approval** (`approval.isActive: true`) to log in and use the API.

| role | created by | email verification | approval at start | can |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| superadmin | seed (`npm run db:seed`) | already verified | active | create disnakertrans accounts; **read-only** for everything else (users, products, tenants, tenant categories); notified of every new account and product |
| disnakertrans | superadmin (*Register Disnakertrans*) | activation link (24 h) | active | view and activate/deactivate **admin** accounts and **products**, view all products and tenants |
| admin | self sign-up (*Register Admin*) | OTP (15 min) | **inactive** until a disnakertrans activates it | activate tenant accounts **and products**, read users (tenants)/products/tenants, manage tenant categories |
| tenant | self sign-up (*Register Tenant*) | OTP (15 min) | active | manage their own products and tenant profile |

## Saved variables
Requests save what the next ones need: `token`, `currentUserId`, `currentRole` (Login) · `userId`, `userRole`, `registeredEmail`, `otp` / `verifyToken` (Register, Resend) · `resetToken` (Forgot Password) · `imageId`, `imagePath` (Upload Image) · `productId` · `tenantCategoryId` · `tenantProfileId` · `notificationId` · `logId`. Each save is printed in the Postman Console.

## Example walkthrough
1. **Login** as superadmin → **Register Disnakertrans** → **Verify Email Link** (or open the link from the email).
2. **Register Admin** → **Verify OTP** (code from the email, or `{{otp}}` in development).
3. Set `loginEmail` = the disnakertrans email, `loginPassword` = `{{newUserPassword}}` → **Login** → **Activate / Deactivate User** with `userId` = the admin's id and `userRole` = `admin`.
4. **Login** as the admin → **Create Tenant Category**.
5. **Register Tenant** → **Verify OTP** → **Login** as the tenant → **Upload Image** → **Create My Tenant** → **Upload Image** again → **Create Product**.
6. **Login** as the admin → **List Notifications** → **Activate / Deactivate Product** → **Landing Products** shows it.

## Responses
- Success: `{ "success": true, "data": …, "meta"?: { page, limit, total, totalPages } | { verification } }`
- Error: `{ "success": false, "error": { "code", "message", "details"? } }`
- `message` and `details[].message` are in **Bahasa Indonesia** (ready to show in the frontend). `code` and `field` stay in English; frontend logic should switch on `code`.

| status | code (examples) | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `BAD_REQUEST`, `ID_NOT_PROVIDED` | invalid input (`details` lists the fields) |
| 400 | `OTP_INVALID`, `OTP_EXPIRED`, `LINK_INVALID`, `LINK_EXPIRED`, `RESET_LINK_INVALID`, `RESET_LINK_EXPIRED` | wrong or expired verification code / link / password reset link |
| 401 | `UNAUTHORIZED` | no/invalid/expired/logged-out token, or the password was reset → log in again |
| 403 | `FORBIDDEN`, `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED`, `USER_NOT_ACTIVATED` | wrong role, email not verified yet, or account not activated |
| 404 | `NOT_FOUND` | not found, or not yours |
| 409 | `UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT`, `STILL_IN_USE`, `CONFLICT`, `EMAIL_ALREADY_VERIFIED` | duplicate value, record still in use, already verified |
| 413 | `FILE_TOO_LARGE` | image over 5 MB |
| 429 | `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS` | a new verification code was requested less than 60 seconds ago |

## Notifications and realtime
Every role gets notifications for the events that concern them (see **Notifications**); activation notifications include the `approval` with `userId` and the `user`. They arrive live over Socket.IO as `notification:new` (see **Realtime (WebSocket)** for connecting in Postman and in the frontend).

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Login, logout, registration, email verification, forgot password and your own account (`/api/auth`).

**Login** saves the token to `{{token}}`, which every other request uses. To act as another role, change `loginEmail` / `loginPassword` (or the body) and send Login again.

| account | registered by | email verification | approval (`isActive`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| disnakertrans | superadmin (*Register Disnakertrans*) | activation **link** in the email (valid 24 h) | active right away |
| admin | themselves (*Register Admin*, public) | 6-digit **OTP** in the email (valid 15 min) | **inactive** until a disnakertrans activates it |
| tenant | themselves (*Register Tenant*, public) | 6-digit **OTP** in the email (valid 15 min) | active right away |

Every new account starts with `mailActive: false`: login and every endpoint that needs a token answer **403 `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED`** until the email is verified. Emails are in Bahasa Indonesia.

**Development:** without `SMTP_HOST` in `.env`, emails are not sent but printed in the server log, and the register/resend responses include `meta.verification.devCode` / `devLink`, which the requests save as `{{otp}}` / `{{verifyToken}}`.

**Forgot password:** *Forgot Password* emails a link to the frontend page `<FRONTEND_URL>/reset-password?userId=…&token=…` (valid 30 minutes, single use). That page calls *Check Reset Link*, then *Reset Password* with the new password. A reset ends every existing session.

request.description:
**Access:** public, no token

Logs in and saves the access token as `{{token}}` (valid for 1 hour), plus `{{currentUserId}}` and `{{currentRole}}`.

- superadmin: the seed account (`SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL` / `SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD` in `.env`)
- disnakertrans / admin / tenant: an account made with the Register requests (password `{{newUserPassword}}`; the email is saved as `{{registeredEmail}}`)

Errors: 401 wrong email/password, 403 `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` (verify the email first; `details` has `userId` and `method`), 403 `USER_NOT_ACTIVATED` (account not activated yet). Forgot the password? Use *Forgot Password*.

`data.user` is the full profile, the same as *Get Me* (`faceImage`, `approval`), so the photo can be shown right after login.

item.description:
Activate / deactivate accounts and products: `PATCH /api/approvals/:id?type=user|product`. `:id` is the **user id** or **product id** (not the approval id).

| type | who can | what |
|---|---|---|
| `user` | disnakertrans → admin accounts; admin → tenant accounts | an inactive account cannot log in, and is disconnected from realtime right away |
| `product` | disnakertrans, admin | active products appear on the landing page |

The superadmin is **read-only** and cannot activate anything (disnakertrans accounts it creates are active right away). Every deactivation of an account notifies the superadmins (`USER_DEACTIVATED`).

Every approval has a `type` (`user` = account approval, `product` = product approval) and a `userId` (the account, or the tenant who owns the product).

item.name: Notifications
item.description:
Notifications for every role (`/api/notifications`, Bearer `{{token}}`). They are created automatically by actions in the other folders.

| type | who gets it | when |
|---|---|---|
| `USER_REGISTERED` | superadmin | any new account (disnakertrans, admin, tenant) |
| `ADMIN_PENDING_ACTIVATION` | disnakertrans | a new admin signed up (needs activation) |
| `PRODUCT_SUBMITTED` | superadmin, admin, disnakertrans | a tenant creates a product |
| `USER_DEACTIVATED` | superadmin | a disnakertrans or admin deactivates a user account |
| `PRODUCT_DEACTIVATED` | superadmin | an admin or disnakertrans takes down a **live** product |
| `PRODUCT_PUBLISHED` | admin, disnakertrans | an admin or disnakertrans activates a product (now on the landing page) |
| `PRODUCT_UPDATED` | admin, disnakertrans | a tenant updates a product |
| `TENANT_PROFILE_UPDATED` | admin | a tenant updates their tenant profile |
| `TENANT_REGISTERED` | admin | a new tenant signs up |
| `PRODUCT_UNDER_REVIEW` | tenant (owner) | they create a product |
| `PRODUCT_APPROVED` | tenant (owner) | their product is activated (also when re-activated) |
| `PRODUCT_TAKEN_DOWN` | tenant (owner) | an admin or disnakertrans rejects or deactivates their product; the description ends with `Reason: <reason>` |
| `PRODUCT_CHANGES_SAVED` | tenant (owner) | they edit their product (says whether it stays live or waits for review) |
| `PRODUCT_REVIEWED` | tenant (owner) | a visitor reviews their product (`<name> gave "<product>" <stars> stars: <review>`) |

Each notification: `id`, `type` (switch on it in the frontend), `name` (title), `description` (message), `entityType` + `entityId` (what to open: `user`, `product` or `tenant`), `approvalId` + `approval`, `isRead`, `readAt`, `createdAt`.

**Activation notifications** (`USER_REGISTERED`, `ADMIN_PENDING_ACTIVATION`, `TENANT_REGISTERED`, `PRODUCT_SUBMITTED`, `PRODUCT_UNDER_REVIEW`, `PRODUCT_PUBLISHED`, `PRODUCT_APPROVED`, `PRODUCT_DEACTIVATED`, `PRODUCT_TAKEN_DOWN`, `PRODUCT_CHANGES_SAVED`, `PRODUCT_REVIEWED`, `USER_DEACTIVATED`) include the approval of the user/product they are about:
```json
"approval": { "id": 137, "type": "user", "userId": "<id>", "isActive": false, "reason": "Waiting for activation by disnakertrans", "updatedAt": "...",
  "user": { "id": "<id>", "firstName": "Andi", "lastName": "Wijaya", "email": "...", "phoneNumber": "...", "role": "admin", "tenantName": null, ... } }
```
`approval.isActive` is the **current** status (not a copy from when it was sent), so the frontend can show an *Activate* button only while it is still `false`. To activate: `PATCH /api/approvals/{entityId}?type={entityType}` (body `{ "isActive": true, "role": "admin" }` for users, `{ "isActive": true }` for products). Other notifications (`PRODUCT_UPDATED`, `TENANT_PROFILE_UPDATED`) have `approvalId: null`, `approval: null`. If the product is deleted, `approval` becomes `null`. Every user only ever sees their own notifications (others → 404).

Endpoints: `GET /api/notifications?page=&limit=&unread=true` (newest first, `meta.unreadCount` for the badge), `GET /api/notifications/unread-count`, `PATCH /api/notifications/:id/read`, `PATCH /api/notifications/read-all`, `DELETE /api/notifications/:id`. `approval.user` is whose approval it is (the account owner, or the tenant who owns the product); it never contains the password.

item.name: Logs
item.description:
Request and error logs of the API (`/api/logs`, Bearer `{{token}}`), **superadmin only**, read-only.

Every **create / update / delete** request (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) gets one row when its response is sent; reads (GET) are not stored. A row has: `method`, `path`, `query`, `statusCode`, `durationMs`, `level` (`info` < 400, `warn` 4xx, `error` 5xx), who made it (`userId`, `userEmail`, `userRole`; null for guests), `ip`, `userAgent`. `requestFields` (the **names** of the sent fields, never their values, plus `image` for an upload) and `responseSummary` (a safe extract of a successful response: allowlisted keys such as `id`, `name`, `email`, `role`, `isActive`, `price`, `stars`, also inside `user` / `approval` / `product` / `tenant`; a list gives `{ count }`; tokens and passwords can never appear). A failed request also has the error the client got (`errorCode`, `errorMessage`, `errorDetails`); a 5xx also keeps the real error's stack trace in `errorStack` (only in *Get Log*; the client never sees it).

- Request bodies are never stored, and secret query values (`token`, `otp`, `password`, `code`) are saved as `***`.
- Rows older than `LOG_RETENTION_DAYS` (default 30) are deleted daily.
